title: Insufficient parameter sanitization in AMD Secure Processor (ASP) TEE DrvSys could allow an attacker with local access…
description: CVE-2024-36344 describes a vulnerability in the AMD Secure Processor (ASP) Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) DrvSys component where insufficient parameter sanitization can lead to an out-of-bounds write. This flaw requires local access to the TEE interface or a Trusted Application (TA). Exploitation could result in loss of platform integrity or denial of service. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS 4.0 base score of 6.9. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
